name: Environmental Causality Baseline Acceptance + Evolution Decision

gate.evidence: P1A-S1 resolution-independence plus P1A-S3 presentation-only lab; S1 hash unchanged

gate.criterion: one fixed genome creates spatially different viability and biomass
gate.evidence: P1A-S2 235/235 with favourable, marginal and unsustainable zones

gate.criterion: local outcomes explainable through explicit resource/cost breakdown
gate.evidence: P1A-S2 resource balance plus P1A-S3 ENV/RESP/LIMIT/ENERGY/BIO/WHY diagnostics
P1A-S1 continuous fields and P1A-S4 hidden-biome source scan PASS

gate.criterion: at least one structural trade-off demonstrated
gate.evidence: root-depth benefit/cost is non-monotonic globally and has opposite dry-ridge versus wet-floodplain local effects

gate.criterion: same seed/revision replay produces identical hashes
gate.evidence: S1/S2 accepted hashes plus P1A-S4 same-process and fresh-process exact replay

gate.criterion: controlled trait probes move niches in explainable directions
gate.evidence: P1A-S3 controlled probes and graphical/manual confirmation

gate.criterion: baseline biomass bounded with no total extinction/runaway
gate.evidence: P1A-S4 global_extinction PASS and unbounded_biomass PASS_BOUNDED_FAR_BELOW_CAP

gate.criterion: visual and headless evidence share one truth model
gate.evidence: P1A-S3 graphical PASS with unchanged accepted S1/S2/S3 hashes and presentation-only truth boundary

decision_effect.p1b_rule: Start from one ancestor. Mutation and selection must discover adaptive strategies; controlled S3 probes are diagnostics only and must not seed species roles.
decision_effect.ph0_rule: Development traits may now be contracted in parallel, but must preserve accepted P1A ecology truth and must not introduce canonical TREE/BUSH/GRASS types or renderer-dependent genome/resource hashes.
